default.notes: A visa must be obtained in advance from an Algerian consulate — typically requiring an invitation or hotel bookings, travel insurance and a consular fee. Tourists on organised far-south Sahara tours may instead use the visa-on-arrival scheme via an accredited agency.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 90 days under bilateral agreements — confirm the exact allowance before a long stay.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are not admitted to Algeria.

DZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Algerian citizens.
